$description: The Conference template's own component tokens (Q64): each aliases a core semantic role, so its parts follow the theme and every context.

gap.$description: Between the countdown's words and its figure.

value-size.$description: The size of the time left.

value-weight.$description: The weight of the time left.

level-gap.$description: Between one level of sponsors and the next.

tile-gap.$description: Between sponsor tiles in a level.

tile-padding.$description: Inside a sponsor tile, around its name.

tile-surface.$description: A tile's one enclosure: a quiet surface, no border.

name-l.$description: A sponsor's name in the lead level.

name-m.$description: A sponsor's name in the middle levels.

name-s.$description: A sponsor's name in the smallest level.

mark-l.$description: The height of a sponsor's mark in the lead level.

mark-m.$description: The height of a sponsor's mark in the middle levels.

mark-s.$description: The height of a sponsor's mark in the smallest level.

column-gap.$description: Between the intro column and the levels.

intro-width.$description: The intro column's width beside the levels in a wide window.

stack-gap.$description: Between the parts of the intro.
